measurementConventions: Every measured application action is recorded through measureLmsActions. Counts are derived from completed actions; JS dialogs and visible application dialogs are observed. Explicit business commits are confirmations; disclosure, navigation and download are not. Semantic fill is counted separately from physical keystrokes. Elapsed time includes required response waits and verification readback; screenshots after finish are excluded. Initial director/employer authentication and fixture construction are preconditions, never claimed as first-entry work.
